verdict.rationale: Canny publishes a first-party API reference at developers.canny.io/api-reference, which shows a documented public API exists. The pack gives only the page title, though, so its scope (endpoints, auth, write operations) is unshown. No OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. The MCP server is a separate capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of API scope and endpoints, authentication and write-operation details, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
